text:
Noah: quick thread to prep HelixLane co-sell POC kickoff. target: embeddings + assistant flow, peak 150 rps, 95th <350ms. need network plan, security questionnaire, and a pricing note for a 3-week pilot.
Priya: can we support their ask for an isolated tenant + SAML SSO? they also want logs forwarded to their Splunk instance.
Omar: tenant ok. Splunk forwarding requires opening outbound to splunk-intake. do we want VPC peering or private endpoint? peering gives lower latency but adds setup steps.
Jillian: security side: vendor questionnaire required, plus evidence of SOC2 and data processing agreement (DPA). also confirm data retention policy and subprocessor list.
Marta - HelixLane: hi everyone, Marta here. HelixLane prefers VPC peering if possible. we can accept a 30-day retention window for demo logs. we need an estimate for run cost; prefer to avoid heavy compute. Any light-weight model suggestions?
Noah: we can propose a quantized 6B variant for the embeddings-heavy workload; fallback to 13B if quality diff > threshold. will document a canary rollout.
deploy-bot: provisioning request received. creating tenant...
deploy-bot: Tenant ready: id=tn-5588, region=us-east-1, endpoint=https://us-east-1.redwood.example/tenants/tn-5588 ✅
Priya: SAML SSO yes — we support IdP initiated SSO. need their metadata.xml and test user. For Splunk, we support HTTP event collector keys; share a static egress IP for them to whitelist.
Omar: network todo: 1) allow outbound 443 to our endpoint; 2) if peering: expect ASN exchange and CIDR 10.55.0.0/16; 3) if metrics scraping, open 9100 from their monitoring CIDRs. I'll add a minimal ops checklist to the runbook.
Jillian: sending vendor questionnaire to sec-requests@redwood.example. Marta, please assign a HelixLane security owner so we can close the loop on DPI and retention.
Marta - HelixLane: secops@helixlane.com is our point. we will send SAML metadata and the questionnaire by EOB today. Regarding cost, could you give hosted credits vs short-term dedicated pricing?
Noah: ballpark: hosted credits for 3 weeks w/ 150 rps and caching ~ USD 9k-13k total. Short-term Dedicated (2-week minimum) might be ~USD 6k-9k but requires infra team signoff and commit. Priya will put together a 1-page with assumptions.
Priya: will do. I'll include a perf/cost tradeoff table and a recommended quantized model for latency savings.
Omar: FYI, peering setup lead time ~48-72 hours once both sides approve routes. if they need faster, use API keys + public endpoint.
Jillian: added DPA & SOC2 links to the runbook and attached the questionnaire. please flag any items that require legal or privacy escalation.
Marta - HelixLane: great — we aim to start test traffic next Tuesday. thanks for the fast turnaround.
Noah: agenda for kickoff: 1) confirm SAML metadata and test user 2) network & peering decision 3) security questionnaire status 4) pricing confirmation and rollout plan. See you on the call.
